name: PayNow

evidence.mor: F02: merchant of record and collecting agent; PayNow collects payment, tax and disputes
evidence.billing: F14: automatic subscription renewals with separate orders; F15: trials, coupons and retries
evidence.links: F16: hosted webstore and product storefront links need no custom frontend
evidence.crypto: C03: crypto is accepted at checkout at a 1.5% gateway fee; C02: a third-party provider reviews it

line: Merchant of record for digital products, SaaS and game-server services.

free.text: Free: $0/month, up to $2,000 sales; 3.5% platform fee

cells.type: Merchant of record for digital products
cells.countries: Non-US vendors accepted; full signup list unpublished
cells.payout: Manual after settlement; about 24 hours after payout is sent

fee.math: The US gateway fee is 2.90% plus $0.30. The Free plan's platform fee is 3.5% of the charge, minus tax and the gateway fee.
The UK gateway fee is 2.90% plus $0.30. The Free plan's platform fee is 3.5% of the charge, minus tax and the gateway fee.
The EU gateway fee is 2.90% plus $0.30. The Free plan's platform fee is 3.5% of the charge, minus tax and the gateway fee.
Published gateway rates cover the US, UK and EU. No India card rate is listed.
